contract: Revisioned owner-configured subscription quota plans bind exact provider names, cycle windows and optional token/dollar ceilings. Summaries reuse canonical local TurnUsage evidence and atomically subtract active local-planning reservations. Provider-reported percentages remain separate typed adapter evidence and never create ceilings, entitlement or runtime admission. HTTP/UI can configure, inspect, reserve and release planning capacity but cannot write provider evidence or grant provider capacity.
remaining_limits: No provider account adapter is wired in this slice, so live provider quota evidence remains absent rather than inferred
Configured availability and reservations are local planning controls; they do not grant provider entitlement or enforce runtime admission
Historical canonical usage without matching provider identity is not attributed to a plan
Dashboard registration, Platform page composition, native tool registration and durability inventory enrollment for capabilities/platform_quotas.sqlite3 remain root-owned integration hooks
acceptance_coverage: revisioned owner-configured plan terms with explicit source and bounded cycle
canonical provider-matched local usage projection with unpriced evidence retained
atomic token/dollar reservations prevent concurrent overbooking and expose expiry
idempotent release returns configured planning capacity and preserves history
typed provider evidence remains read-only through HTTP and does not alter configured availability
home isolation, no-store HTTP responses, conflict handling and no entitlement/admission routes
real HTTP React plan, usage, reserve, release, overbooking error and missing-provider-evidence workflow
